gates.evidence: The surface s09 (Character Details) for Willson Wáng is SFW and age-appropriate.
The offer rewards playing a mini-game to unlock content, with no incentivized clicks, installs, or cash-like rewards.
The offer uses gain framing ('Unlock Premium Scenario') with a clear decline option ('No thanks').
The user must tap 'Play Now' on the offer card to initiate the ad.
The exact reward (72-hour access) and action (play a quick game / 15s) are disclosed prior to the ad.
An equally legible decline button 'No thanks' is present and returns the user to the screen without penalty.
The offer triggers on a button tap in character details before chat starts, never during a streaming response.
Eligibility is explicitly restricted to non-subscribers only.

scores.evidence: Unlocking scenarios on character details aligns with content needs (TAX-3), but introduces a new monetization anchor not present in the base app.
The proposal specifies removesFreeValue: true, gating previously free content behind ads, which harms user trust and product integrity.
Gated to non-subscribers with a 72-hour expiry and daily cap of 3, protecting subscription value.
Cost to serve per view is $0.0000, well below US revenue per view ($0.0090–$0.0150).
Triggered when viewing character details (m6), which occurs regularly in the discovery loop.
Maps to SIM-RWD unit, but introduces ungrounded UI elements and edge cases noted in code gates.
References character 'Willson Wáng' from digest, but assumes scenario locking mechanics that do not exist in Janitor.
Includes explicit per-day cap of 3 and 60-minute cooldown.
Defines primary metric (Scenario views per DAU), guardrails, and a 10% user-level holdout for 4 weeks.

requiredChanges: Ground the proposal in existing Janitor features or explicitly document the product change required to introduce scenario gating.
Remove removesFreeValue: true or apply scenario locking only to newly created premium scenarios to prevent user churn and backlash.
Correct the UI element grounding to match actual elements on screen s09.
parsed.topConcern: Introducing a product change that removes free access to existing character scenarios (removesFreeValue: true) creates severe trust and churn risk for free users.
